title: Separator
description: A hairline that divides without decorating. Plain, labelled, and vertical forms.
usage: Use it between groups of content. If everything needs a separator, the grouping is wrong. The labelled form is for alternatives (OR) and section breaks in forms.
a11y: The plain form is a native <hr> (role="separator"); use role="separator" on other elements only when the division carries meaning, and aria-hidden="true" on purely visual ones such as the vertical form. Every line is a 1px border, so it stays visible in forced-colors mode.
